originalTitle: S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow Begin Week Higher As Anthropic IPO Filing Rekindles AI Enthusiasm — MSFT, AAPL, CART, VZ In Focus
summary: Investors now look forward to quarterly earnings from Microsoft, Amazon, and Alphabet due this week.
content: The S&P 500 ended Monday 0.7% higher, the Nasdaq 100 rose 1.1%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 0.3%.Anthropic publicly filed for an IPO on Monday.Apple iPhone Duo receives multiple customer complaints regarding cracked screens.U.S. stock indices ended higher on Monday after Anthropic filed for an IPO, boosting investor optimism in the AI space, while investors await quarterly results from top tech firms and the Federal Reserve’s October policy meeting decision. The S&P 500 ended Monday 0.7% higher, the Nasdaq 100 rose 1.1%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 0.3%. The Russell 2000, which tracks small-cap stocks, added 0.4%.The SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) gained 0.7%, and the SPDR Dow Jones Industrial Average ETF (DIA) rose 0.3%. Meanwhile, the Nasdaq-100 tracking Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) ended 1.2% higher on Monday. Meanwhile, the VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) and the iShares Semiconductor ETF jumped about 3% each on Monday as gains in AMD, Micron Tech (MU) and Nvidia (NVDA). The broader Vanguard Information Technology ETF (VGT) rose 1.5%.Retail sentiment on Stocktwits for SPY, DIA and QQQ was ‘bearish’ with ‘high’ message volumes.US Market DriversIndexMoveCloseDow Jones Industrial Average0.3% 52,361.58 S&P 5000.7%7,676.77 Nasdaq 1001.1%29,273.40 Anthropic (ANTHZZX) on Monday released its public IPO filing, which showed that more than 1,900 customers paid the Claude AI maker at least $1 million over the past year, nearly double the tally in April.The company is targeting a public listing in November, according to The Wall Street Journal, though the timing could change. The report said Anthropic’s offering could raise $100 billion or more at a valuation of $1.5 trillion to $2 trillion. The company behind Claude expects to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the symbol ANT.Meanwhile, Meta Platforms’ (META) plan to raise $95 billion to support its AI investments and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk’s statement over the weekend that the satellite and rocket launch company has closed a $40 billion debt deal for AI chips kept risks around ballooning hyperscaler debt elevated. Over to energy markets, Brent futures fell 0.8% to settle at $115.81 a barrel, while U.S. West Texas Intermediate slid 1.7% to $101.57 per barrel, also aiding overall market sentiment at the beginning of the week.Going ahead, investors would shift attention to quarterly updates from Microsoft (MSFT), Amazon (AMZN) and Google parent Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) due later this week. The Federal Reserve's policy announcement is also due this week on Wednesday. Pricing in Fed funds futures markets indicates a 90% probability that central bank officials will leave interest rates unchanged within the existing 3.75% to 4% range.Key Trending StocksMicrosoft Corp.(MSFT) is launching a workforce reduction initiative, extending voluntary buyout offers to approximately 60,000 employees, Bloomberg reported. Verizon CEO Dan Schulman on Monday dismissed the near-term threat from SpaceX’s Starlink ambitions, arguing that any serious challenge in the U.S. mobile market would require a full terrestrial network costing hundreds of billions of dollars and taking four to six years to build. Apple Inc.’s (AAPL) highly anticipated entry into the foldable smartphone market has hit an early roadblock, with a growing faction of consumers taking to social media to report cracks in the inner screens of their iPhone Duo devices. Shares of Instacart (CART) jumped 8% on Monday following reports that rival delivery firm DoorDash (DASH) is in talks to acquire it in a deal valuing the company at $17 billion. Shares of NextNav (NN) jumped 12% on Monday after SpaceX (SPCX) pushed for inclusion of its lower 900 MHz spectrum band in the Federal Communications Commission’s (FCC) proposed expansion of satellite-to-mobile spectrum. chineseTitle: Anthropic IPO 申请重燃 AI 热情，标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克指数、道琼斯指数一周走高 — MSFT、AAPL、CART、VZ 成为焦点
chineseSummary: 投资者现在期待微软、亚马逊和 Alphabet 将于本周公布的季度财报。
chineseContent: 标普500指数周一收高0.7%，纳斯达克100指数上涨1.1%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨0.3%。Anthropic周一公开申请IPO。苹果iPhone Duo收到多起客户关于屏幕破裂的投诉。 Anthropic 申请 IPO 后，周一股指收高，提振了投资者对人工智能领域的乐观情绪，同时投资者也在等待顶级科技公司的季度业绩和美联储 10 月份的政策会议决定。标准普尔 500 指数周一收高 0.7%，纳斯达克 100 指数上涨 1.1%，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨 0.3%。追踪小盘股的罗素 2000 指数上涨 0.4%。SPDR S&P 500 ETF (SPY) 上涨 0.7%，SPDR 道琼斯工业平均指数 ETF (DIA) 上涨 0.3%。与此同时，追踪 Invesco QQQ Trust (QQQ) 的纳斯达克 100 指数周一收高 1.2%。与此同时，随着 AMD、美光科技 (MU) 和英伟达 (NVDA) 的上涨，VanEck Semiconductor ETF (SMH) 和 iShares Semiconductor ETF 周一各上涨约 3%。更广泛的先锋信息技术 ETF (VGT) 上涨 1.5%。Stocktwits 上的零售情绪对 SPY、DIA 和 QQQ 的情绪“看跌”，消息量“高”。美国市场驱动因素指数移动收盘道琼斯工业平均指数 0.3% 52,361.58 标准普尔 5000.7%7,676.77 纳斯达克 1001.1%29,273.40 Anthropic (ANTHZZX) 周一发布了其公开 IPO 文件，显示超过 1,900 名客户在过去一年中向这家 Claude AI 制造商支付了至少 100 万美元，几乎是 4 月份的两倍。 据《华尔街日报》报道，该公司计划于 11 月公开上市，不过时间可能会发生变化。报告称，Anthropic 的发行可能筹集 1000 亿美元或更多资金，估值为 1.5 万亿至 2 万亿美元。克劳德背后的公司预计将开始在纳斯达克全球交易所交易
